_comment: Public-domain three-view references for the silhouette gate (US War Department / Navy Department publications, US federal government works). Page images come from the Internet Archive scans; crop = [x0, y0, x1, y1] in pixels of the page image as served at page/n<N>_w1600.jpg (full scan width). Span/length are the drawing captions (feet+inches -> metres). The three largest dark blobs inside the crop, ordered top to bottom, are the front, top and side views (side: nose left).
